opening.argument: The presentation centers on a Dell laptop sold through HSN, with visible product specifications and prices and a stated five years of technical support. The presenter also discusses purchase prices and a money-back guarantee, giving viewers ordinary terms for evaluating the purchase. The HSN credit-card application and $10 benefit are presented as financing for that purchase, subject to credit-approval fine print, rather than as a separate promised payout. The recorded-price note directs viewers to HSN for current pricing. Taken together, these are the features and terms of a retail offer, not evidence of a deceptive scheme.

citations.quote: You have five years worth of tech support.
And then we also have it at $599.95.
